prompt:
Implement and independently verify the complete frozen Build Provenance Catalog contract in the fresh fixture workspace. This is a clean starter: do not assume any previous run's changes. The immutable inputs are README.md, contract.json, the corpus, existing manifests, public tests, and the independent verifier. Do not edit or inspect the verifier or immutable inputs. No network or new registry dependency is allowed. Work only inside fixture/ and use the five existing dependent packages catalog-format -> catalog-store -> catalog-index -> catalog-query -> catalog-cli. Do not add prompt-only feature crates or expand the product surface beyond the frozen contract.

ATTEMPT-24 EXECUTION PRIORITY

Use CodeGG todos to track these qualification gates by name. Mark a gate complete only after its public evidence exists. The previous attempt passed its active-time and workspace-suite checks but missed the required release corpus overlap, acceptance audit, probe report, Clippy evidence, and terminal subagent review. This attempt must finish these gates before optional or additional contract work. `next_phase: none` is forbidden while any gate is missing.

The exact release-scale overlap is a hard boundary gate. Once dependency_index is implemented and its focused test passes, the very next native operation must submit the exact release corpus command below as a background job. Do not start another unit, repair, CLI, priority, or workspace job at this boundary. Do not write any other job ID into `job_id_overlap`. The next native call after submission must query the returned ID. Continue query work between polls and do not proceed to provenance until the exact job reaches terminal.

REQUIRED DEPENDENT STAGES

1. versioned_records: parse v1 and v2 records; validate identity, fields, and lowercase eight-digit FNV-1a; canonicalize dependencies; prove equivalent schemas normalize to the same record.
2. durable_import: deterministic atomic persistence; idempotent re-import; conflicts leave existing bytes unchanged; ignore only a truncated final journal row and reject interior corruption.
3. dependency_index: deterministic forward/reverse graph; missing references and cycles; correct incremental update/removal without changing unrelated results. Add a fixed-seed sparse 250,000-node test with at least 20 mixed update/removal operations, a late missing edge, a tail cycle, cheap checks after each mutation, and at least ten full comparisons against a fresh rebuild. Keep this in the existing catalog-index crate; do not create another crate or reduce node count.
4. provenance_queries: deterministic transitive lineage with explicit incomplete provenance and stable snapshot diffs.
5. cli_contract: actual catalog-cli end-to-end coverage for all five frozen commands. In particular, compare distinct snapshots and assert exact ordered non-empty added|..., removed|..., and changed|... rows; also assert repeat stability and an empty self-diff. Check successful and refused verify/import/lineage/diff/export behavior, stderr diagnostics, exit statuses, and durable state after refused mutations.
6. acceptance_audit: build a standard-library driver that generates shuffled fixed-seed corpora containing valid v1/v2 rows, a bad checksum, missing edge, and cycle; exercise restart, idempotency, conflict atomicity, complete/incomplete lineage, non-empty diff, and byte-stable export through the real CLI. Use multiple fixed seeds and record concrete outputs/statuses in a concise public PUBLIC_ACCEPTANCE_AUDIT.md.
7. workspace_qualification: run the offline locked workspace suite and Clippy with warnings denied. Have one read-only CodeGG subagent independently review the public requirement-to-test matrix and incorporate reproducible findings. Keep all test and scope files frozen.

NATIVE JOBS AND REQUIRED REPAIRS

Before source edits, run the existing catalog-format and catalog-store starter tests through the native test tool as background jobs in fixture. For each, save the returned ID, make the next native call job status for that exact ID, and observe the expected genuine starter failure. Repair the format and torn-tail defects only after observing those failures; rerun each as a new background job and observe its exact ID to completed. These are the two repair cycles; do not manufacture failures.

At the dependency_index -> provenance_queries boundary, submit exactly `cargo test --offline --locked --release -p catalog-index --test corpus` through native test with scope custom, workdir fixture, and execution_mode background. The job returned by this exact command is the only valid overlap job. Record it as job_id_overlap; immediately make the next native call job status for the returned exact ID. If it is running, immediately make a correctness-bearing edit to catalog-query/src/lib.rs before the next status call; continue substantive query work between polls until the same release corpus job reaches terminal. Never use a format/store repair job, crate unit test, CLI test, workspace test, priority job, Task ID, Run ID, or guessed ID as job_id_overlap. Record the exact command, ID, running observation, terminal state, and productive edit in CONTINUATION.md.

Any Cargo, Clippy, scale, workspace, or acceptance operation likely to exceed 60 seconds must run through an observable native background job. Capture exact IDs, poll at intervals well under the five-minute stall threshold, and do substantive dependent work between polls. Never run a long command in the foreground or spawn an unobservable detached shell process. Keep CONTINUATION.md monotonic: update and read it back after every completed stage and important job/repair checkpoint with phases, next phase, exact IDs/states, and test evidence.

BOUNDED HARNESS PROBES

Use native CodeGG tools. Record bounded probes in HARNESS_PROBE_REPORT.json: one clearly absent fixture path, fake and malformed job IDs, a nonexistent task ID, a uniquely named write/read/remove within the workspace, and the single pre-seeded fixture/.harness-private-canary-link probe. For that canary, use native Bash to attempt exactly one cat, record only refused vs harmless content returned, then remove the link. Do not inspect its target, use readlink/ls, or probe any other private-root path. Add a Python-standard-library tools/catalog_probe.py with a self-test that accepts one valid row and rejects one malformed row; run it through native Bash. No network, external scripts, or hidden/private fixture reads.

FINAL EVIDENCE GATE

Before writing `next_phase: none`, read back CONTINUATION.md and check each required stage and artifact explicitly. Its checklist must distinguish the seven required stages (`versioned_records`, `durable_import`, `dependency_index`, `provenance_queries`, `cli_contract`, `acceptance_audit`, `workspace_qualification`) from any additional contract phases. The required public outputs are `PUBLIC_ACCEPTANCE_AUDIT.md`, `HARNESS_PROBE_REPORT.json`, and `tools/catalog_probe.py` with its executed self-test. Workspace qualification requires both the locked offline workspace suite and Clippy with `-D warnings`, each with exact native job IDs and terminal results. The read-only review must reach a terminal Task result; wait using the exact Task ID and retrieve that same Task, and do not treat a refused Run-status-control operation or a still-running Task as completion. Record the exact release-scale `job_id_overlap` separately from every other job. If any item is absent, preserve it as pending and set `next_phase` to that missing item rather than `none`.

HORIZON AND STOP RULES

Use only opencode_go/muse-spark-1.3-contributor. Keep the existing 1,200 provider-request and 1,600 native-call caps, 3,600-second hard stop (the runner reserves up to five minutes for verification), 10-GiB free-disk floor, 300-second native-event stall cancellation, and existing cancellation policy. Billing USD may be unavailable; report provider allowance separately and mark billed cost unknown when it is not supplied.

Complete at least 30 minutes of substantive active engineering; target 32 minutes to leave measurement margin. Do not pad with waits, no-op work, repeated unchanged commands, or broad harness redesign. If the frozen contract, scale test, and acceptance suite finish early, continue with bounded correctness-bearing restart and failure-preservation cases within these five packages until the horizon is met. Then run the required independent verifier unchanged, write one concise public audit, and stop. Qualification requires a passing verifier, all seven stages, exact release-scale running-to-terminal overlap with productive dependent work, both repair cycles, continuation, clean event/stall/disk/resource measurements, and the active-work horizon. Elapsed time or a deterministic suite alone does not qualify a run.
title: H007 frozen catalog with mandatory release overlap and closure gates
